notes.decision: The page numeral as transcribed is ⲛ̄ (= 50), which does not match the modern page-30 label. Preserved as transcribed; possibly a manuscript-internal numbering convention or scribal feature.
Translated 'Death which is king' — ⲣ̄ⲡⲟ = Lycopolitan ⲣ̄-ⲣ̄ⲣⲟ 'be king/reign.' Death personified as cosmic king of false doctrines.
ⲃⲗⲁⲙⲗⲙ = 'defile, befoul' (cf. Sah. ϫⲱϩⲙ̄). The teaching of Error defiles those whom Death has cast down.
ⲕⲁⲧⲥ̄ unattested elsewhere; tentatively rendered 'wicked guile' as parallel/expansion of preceding ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩⲣⲅⲓⲁ ('craftiness'). ⲃⲱⲛⲉ = 'evil/wickedness' is well-attested.
Distinct from ⲡⲃⲣⲉ ('seed'). ⲃⲉⲣⲃⲉ likely 'seeds' here as plural, but possibly 'sprouts/shoots.' Translated 'seeds' for context (recognition of evil seeds within doctrines).

ϩⲙⲉ tentatively read as Lycopolitan reflex of ⲙⲁⲥⲧⲉ 'hate.' ⲣⲃⲁⲗ = ⲣ̄-ⲃⲟⲗ 'outsider, foreign one.' Context: those who recognize evil seeds in true knowledge will hate them as alien to their proper nature.
Unclear. Possibly ⲧⲟⲩ-ⲙⲡⲡⲉ 'their counted/portion' or a contracted form of 'their nature/lot.' Translated tentatively 'their nature' as paired with ⲡⲟⲩⲥⲛⲁϩ ('their bond').

notes.coptic_form: ⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ ... ⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ... ⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲛⲁ ... ⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ ... ⲧⲡⲧⲉ
notes.decision: Standard Manichaean five-fold dark cosmology: five storehouses, five archons, five spirits, five bodies, five tastes — each register corresponding to the five worlds (smoke, fire, wind, water, darkness).
Read as ⲧⲡⲉ 'taste' — gustatory correspondence-register completing the five-fold schema. Each dark world has its taste-correspondence as its bodily register.
Greek loanword στοιχεῖον 'element.' The orthography ⲥⲧⲟⲭⲉⲓϣⲛ at start of line 20 may be a scribal slip for ⲥⲧⲟⲭⲉⲓⲱⲛ; preserved as transcribed.
Lexeme unclear. Translated 'wellspring' interpretively, fitting the context of 'origin/source of all evil and wickedness.' Possibly related to a root meaning 'pit, abyss, source.'
ⲥⲱⲣ = 'scatter, spread.' The ⲧⲃⲛ- prefix unclear, possibly intensifier or article + nominalizer. Translated 'scattering-forth' to capture the noun of action.
Abstract noun from ⲧⲱⲛ 'rise up against, contend' — 'contention, strife.' Doubled ⲧⲧ may be writing convention.
πύλη + ⲥⲱⲭⲉ. ⲥⲱⲭⲉ tentatively rendered 'slaughter/wounding' — fits the martial inventory (battles, dangers, gates of X). Possibly related to a root meaning 'strike, smite.'
ⲭⲁⲥⲉ = 'high, lofty' (Lycopolitan reflex of ⲭⲱⲥⲉ/ϫⲓⲥⲉ — cf. accumulated vocab ⲡⲭⲥⲉ). 'The lofty kingship' = the elevated dominion of the King of Darkness over the dark realms.

ⲉⲕ[...] is the personal name of the King of Darkness, restored by editor as 'ⲉⲕⲓⲁ' (or similar). Possibly Greek αἰκία 'outrage, mistreatment' as personified epithet, or a transliterated demonic name. Reading uncertain.

ⲟⲩⲛ ... ⲛϩⲏⲧϩ = 'there are ... in him.' The King of Darkness has five animal-forms as the five-fold composition of his body — head of lion, hands/feet of demons, shoulders of eagle, belly of dragon, tail of fish (continuing onto next page).
Reading uncertain. The damaged sequence after 'demons and...' may include a second class of evil beings paired with demons (e.g. devils, evil ones), but the abbreviation/orthography ⲓ̈ϩ is unclear.
